STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, top_breach) -> u1
(u0, zombie_killed & !top_breach) -> u0
(u0, else) -> u0
(u1, else) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, top_breach, u1) -> -100.0
(u0, zombie_killed & !top_breach, u0) -> 0.1
feedback: The RM is well-formed and semantically faithful to 'Stop every zombie that walks down the top lane.' FINAL_STATES is nonempty, u0 is declared in STATES, and u0 is accepting for the task: it means 'no top breach has occurred yet,' the machine starts there, and exactly the breach-free traces remain in it, which matches the success condition (an un-killed top-lane zombie must eventually breach, so holding u0 to truncation equals stopping every top-lane zombie). Transition coverage is exhaustive and deterministic: in u0 the labels top_breach and zombie_killed & !top_breach are disjoint, and the else self-loop absorbs every irrelevant event (side_breach, plant_trampled, empty steps, and co-occurrences like side_breach with a kill); in u1 the else self-loop is an absorbing failure sink with no reward, which is correct because a top breach irreversibly fails the task and no regression transition is required or possible. The !top_breach guard on the kill transition is the right pattern for the possible same-step co-occurrence of zombie_killed and top_breach: that step deterministically routes to u1 with -100 and no kill bonus, avoiding any nondeterminism. Rewards are safe and bounded: +0.1 per kill is a dense, small progress signal (at most ~3.7 total given 18-37 entries) and -100 per breach dominates it, so no policy can profitably trade a top breach for kills; the unspecified else transitions default to 0, correctly paying nothing for side breaches, trampled plants, or idle steps, which are all irrelevant to this task. One caveat, not disqualifying: the propositions cannot distinguish which lane a killed zombie walked, so the +0.1 also pays for side-lane kills; this is acceptable shaping because killing side zombies never conflicts with holding the top lane under the dominant breach penalty, and it is the best available proxy with the given event alphabet. Format matches the required template (REWARD_MACHINE header, STATES, INITIAL_STATE, FINAL_STATES, TRANSITION_FUNCTION with (state, label) -> state lines, REWARD_FUNCTION with (state, label, state) -> reward lines, Boolean labels using & and !, and per-state else self-loops).
